purpose: Generate a source-only pair of matched V9 closed-eye components for a low-frequency synchronized idle blink. This is not a new face, emotion, or whole-face runtime frame.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for V9 identity, eye scale, friendly rounded line weight, left/right anchor spacing and monochrome treatment

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the only image reference. No historical sleep candidate, legacy face, or rejected art is an image-generation input.

blink_contract.shape: one short gentle rounded closed-eye stroke per component, not an eyelid arc with lashes and not a new eye shape
blink_contract.native_target: each exported mask is placed at the locked V9 eye-body anchor and must fit the original eye footprint without changing brows, mouth, nose, cheeks or highlights
blink_contract.motion: enter closed, hold briefly, reopen; no blink-driven gaze offset

native_review_gate.symmetry: left/right masks have matched visual mass within 2 black pixels after mirror normalization
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject lashes, winks, asymmetric eyes, sleepy face, changed eye-body shape, text, decoration or any altered facial component
